source_parent: ROC-02B calibration observer rank/null audit PR #124, SHA f97178ba81c58524cbc6fcff16f0f74ab9c70dde
scope: Calibration-only methodological pilot; original six new ROC-02 model seeds at depths 8 and 16, source-family 4-5 dev data. No sealed family 6-7 inputs or labels evaluated.
basis_init: ROC-02B train-only supervised cross covariance 128x8; QR first k basis columns

optimization.optimizer: Adam on 128xk raw coordinates, QR retraction each update
optimization.train_loss: MSE of centered train-only rank-k ridge predictor of eight one-hot correct delayed-rule labels, ridge=1

leakage.T: last R/2 tied residual updates from h_after_events+R/2
leakage.rank_null_denominator: Median b of exactly 128 SHA256-keyed rank-matched Gaussian subspaces at each specified calibration state
leakage.evaluation: J_lambda = calibration heldout task_MSE + 1 * mean_{states}[(b/median_null_b)^2]; lambda=1 inherited from ROC01 Amendment C
leakage.invalid_denom: stop and report unavailable instead of substituting 0

calibration_split.selection: Eligible gamma candidates with calibration MSE on source-family 4-5 <=1.10*task-only MSE on same calibration data, choose lowest J_lambda on states2,3; if none eligible, select task-only and mark fallback
calibration_split.stress: States 4,5 and calibration task outputs used only after gamma selection; these share calibration source family, so not independent heldout evidence

random_controls: 128 SHA-keyed per state/rank, seeds 941001..941128. Two source ranks 7,8 (odd-rank inclusion).
causal_output_capture: H=(R T)^T(R T) using original fixed readout weight R, compare to matched task-only and random medians, report task utility
primary_reporting: All twelve paired depth/seed models, per-seed task-only vs joint calibration MSE, b/null, total J_lambda, output capture, rank 7 and 8; counts of joint improvement and task budget gate. No new confirmatory gate defined for this retrospective calibration-stage pilot.
method_boundaries: Train-only labels are used to fit U via ridge
Calibration source-family 4-5 used to choose gamma and report calibration; optimism likely
No ROC-02 sealed test data, no true generalization inference
No causal output interception or new model weight training
ROC-02 delayed-rule model calibration accuracy ~22%, so output capture not synonymous with correct reasoning
source_archives: Use already-published ROC-02 model checkpoints PR#114 and ROC-02B nulls PR#124 with exact SHA; share replay scripts, null seeds and score tables
compute_budget: CPU single-thread only, no paid compute
freeze: This config committed before running any new joint optimization
